headline: Card price is a three-regime lever, not a global win-rate dial: near-irrelevant at early (saturated ceiling; buys kill-speed only), the one stage where it cleanly buys wins at mid, and walled at late by a survival/tempo failure. Cross-deck it is a weak, non-monotone predictor because win-path and tempo dominate; point the price at front-loaded/faster-maturing power and it finally converts.

regimes.mechanism: Win-rate already saturated (erosion 0.90->0.96 across ~7x price; penitent flat and declines 0.79->0.74 at 3-4x). Extra budget cashes out as kill-speed (erosion avgRoundsToVictory 2.98->2.53), not wins.

regimes.priceEffect: converts to wins (strongest, roughly linear for HP/DoT decks)
regimes.mechanism: Fights last long enough to bank status. Erosion ladder mid climbs monotone 0.41->0.68 (+27 pts). Cross-deck Pearson ~0.57. NOT universal: penitent (slow DoT) peaks at x2 (0.23) then declines to 0.21.

Survival/tempo wall: avgRoundsToVictory (~5-8) exceeds avgRoundsAll (~3.5-4.1, flat vs price). Price buys offense not survivability, so the death clock is fixed by enemy output. Erosion late 0.04->0.12 (triples, biggest jump at top tier); penitent pinned 0.00-0.01.

recommendations: Stop treating scoreCard price as a win-rate dial: it is a mid-stage, within-deck, HP-damage ordinal signal only; cross-deck price rank does not predict strength.
Price the tempo axis, not just magnitude: reward front-loaded / faster-maturing power plus a sliver of survivability. The fix cards converted +12 pts mid and >2x late for only +0.5 avgSpell.

Make scoreCard alt-win-aware: SWAY/capitulate, Premise/concede and enchant/disenchant currently price at ~0, so whole win engines are invisible and the model ranks alt-win decks backwards (Grace beats pricier Foundry).
Fix the late wall via enemy tempo / player survivability or alt-win exits, not price: erosion gains only +8 pts even at 4x (664 budget) because the death clock is fixed by enemy output.
Re-run with more seeds before trusting fine-grained trends: seeds=2 makes penitent's non-monotone mid wobble and early declines noise-dominated; the erosion mid trend and the late wall survive.
